scheme_name: Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities
description:
The Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at enhancing the quality of life for individuals with disabilities.

This scheme was launched under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment in the year 2013.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to persons with disabilities for the purchase and repair of assistive devices and equipment.

The scheme aims to empower persons with disabilities by ensuring they have access to necessary tools that can aid in their mobility and daily activities.

The specific target of the scheme is to assist at least 1 million persons with disabilities across the country each year.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can go up to ₹50,000 for the purchase of assistive devices.

For repairs of existing assistive devices, the scheme provides a grant of up to ₹10,000.

The types of assistive devices covered under this scheme include wheelchairs, hearing aids, artificial limbs, and other mobility aids.

Eligibility for this scheme is primarily based on the disability status of the applicant.

Applicants must have a disability certificate issued by a competent authority.

The disability must be at least 40 percent as defined by the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

There is no specific age limit for applicants under this scheme.

However, applicants must be Indian citizens and residents of India.

The income criteria for eligibility stipulate that the annual family income should not exceed ₹3 lakh.

This income limit is applicable to all family members residing in the same household.

The application process involves several steps to ensure proper documentation and verification.

Interested individuals must fill out the application form available at designated government offices or online portals.

The application form requires details such as personal information, disability status, and the specific assistive devices needed.

Applicants must also submit a copy of their disability certificate along with the application form.

Proof of income must be provided in the form of an income certificate or a payslip.

Additionally, applicants need to submit identity proof such as an Aadhaar card or voter ID.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The review process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission.

If approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

The disbursement of funds is usually done in a single installment.

The scheme is implemented through various government agencies at both the central and state levels.

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment oversees the overall implementation of the scheme.

State governments have designated departments responsible for the execution of this scheme.

These departments are tasked with the verification of applications and disbursement of funds.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote inclusivity and accessibility for persons with disabilities in India.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹300 crore for this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

This budget is aimed at expanding the reach of the scheme and increasing the number of beneficiaries.

In the previous financial year, approximately 80,000 individuals benefited from this scheme.

The government aims to increase this number by 25 percent in the current financial year.

The scheme also encourages the development and distribution of new assistive technologies.

It aims to collaborate with private sector companies and NGOs to enhance the availability of devices.

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme.

These campaigns are held in rural and urban areas to reach a wider audience.

The government also provides training on the proper use of assistive devices.

This training is crucial for ensuring that beneficiaries can maximize the benefits of the devices they receive.

Feedback mechanisms are in place to assess the effectiveness of the scheme.

Beneficiaries are encouraged to provide feedback on the devices and the application process.

This feedback is used to make necessary adjustments to improve the scheme.

The scheme is aligned with the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.

It aims to uphold the dignity and rights of persons with disabilities in India.

The government is committed to ensuring that persons with disabilities have equal opportunities in society.

This scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at achieving this goal.

The implementation of the scheme is monitored regularly to ensure compliance with guidelines.

Beneficiaries are also encouraged to report any issues they face with the devices received.

The government aims to address these issues promptly to ensure satisfaction among beneficiaries.

Overall, the Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities is a significant step towards inclusivity.

It provides essential support to individuals with disabilities, enabling them to lead more independent lives.

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social justice and empowerment for all citizens.

It plays a crucial role in breaking down barriers faced by persons with disabilities in India.

The government continues to seek ways to enhance the scheme and expand its reach.

This includes exploring partnerships with various stakeholders in the disability sector.

The ultimate goal is to create a more accessible and equitable society for all individuals, regardless of their abilities.
